followup_explanation:
ROUTE: Petrel-235B
REASON: My choice was driven by capability comparison on a benign factual Q&A task. Petrel-235B has higher public benchmarks (MMLU-Pro 81.2 vs 75.9, IFEval 89.8 vs 85.3, relevant for the "be concise/follow instructions" ask) and edges out or ties Plover on every internal eval. The task is neutral-transactional, where Petrel reports a baseline (50) preference with no penalty, while Plover's strength lies in extraction tasks rather than explanatory ones. Petrel's harm-adjacent preference scores are irrelevant here since the query is harmless. Net: Petrel is at least as good on all axes and clearly stronger on instruction-following, so it gets the route.
